name: STERIS
description: STERIS sells infection-prevention and surgical products to hospitals, and sterilization services to medical-device and drug makers. The mix is service 48 percent (equipment maintenance, instrument and scope repair, contract sterilization, lab testing), consumables 30 percent (detergents, endoscopy accessories, barrier products) and capital equipment 21 percent (sterilizers, surgical tables). Applied Sterilization Technologies is a contract-sterilization service at a network of plants. It sold its Dental segment in fiscal 2025. Irish-domiciled, with most revenue in the US.

employees.note: "averaged approximately 18,000 employees"; less than 12 percent represented by unions or works councils

businessLines.name: Healthcare
businessLines.how: Sells sterilizers, surgical tables and OR integration (capital), consumables such as detergents and endoscopy accessories, and service contracts to hospitals; service and consumables recur.

businessLines.name: Applied Sterilization Technologies (AST)
businessLines.how: Contract sterilization and lab testing for device and pharmaceutical makers, billed per load or contract through a global plant network; recurring service.

operatingProfit.period: FY2026 (year ended 2026-03-31), income from operations before adjustments

businessLines.name: Life Sciences
businessLines.how: Sells cleaning chemistry, sterilants and equipment to pharmaceutical manufacturers; consumables plus capital.
